verified_points: Vice-Diretor de Escola is a pedagogical-support work post.
Selection is after school-unit choice among titular teachers in exercise in the municipal network, with Conselho de Escola approval, SME indication and mayoral designation act.
Qualification requires Pedagogy full licensure or postgraduate qualification in Education with pedagogical common base.
Minimum experience is at least 3 years of effective exercise in teaching and/or pedagogical support in official education.
